result.title: Fuse Before Reconstruct: A Novel Reconstruction Paradigm for Multimodal Industrial Anomaly Detection
result.comment: Preprint before peer review. Includes supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/LiZhi-CASIA/FBR
result.summary: Industrial anomaly detection plays a pivotal role in precision manufacturing, where joint analysis of multimodal data emerges as a critical approach to enhance detection accuracy. Feature reconstruction, a dominant paradigm for such joint analysis, is primarily implemented through intra-modal and cross-modal methods, both of which are plagued by significant limitations. Intra-modal reconstruction neglects complementary cross-modal information, while its cross-modal counterpart is prone to projection errors and ambiguous one-to-many mappings (e.g., same textures mapping to multiple geometries), leading to detection failures. To address these limitations, we propose a novel feature reconstruction paradigm, Fuse Before Reconstruct (FBR), which first fuses multimodal features and then performs reconstruction for anomaly detection. Firstly, we propose a bidirectional cross-modal attention mechanism to achieve deep feature complementarity between image and point cloud features, mitigating projection bias through channel alignment and dynamic spatial prior integration. Besides, a learnable pixel-wise gated fusion strategy is adopted to preserve multi-modal structural consistency while optimizing local feature combination. Finally, dual-path collaborative reconstruction is implemented to recover original modal features from the fused representations, where cross-modal consistency constraints effectively eliminate mapping ambiguities. Extensive experiments show that FBR achieves 98.3% I-AUROC on MVTec 3D-AD and 92.6% I-AUROC on Eyecandies, surpassing previous state-of-the-art methods by +2.9% and +4.1%, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「先融合再重建」（FBR）的多模态工业异常检测范式：以双向跨模态注意力对齐图像与点云特征，经像素级门控融合后由双路径重建原模态特征，并用跨模态一致性约束缓解一对多映射歧义。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「融合表征能否重建出模态特有细节」的设计，或可作为检验 LVR 内部状态是否发生视觉信息坍缩的探针，跨模态一致性约束也可能提示证据保真度评价方式；但该工作属工业异常检测，不含推理期 latent 状态生成，可借鉴性需较多核查。
